editorial_note: Positive numerator/denominator scope is stated beside the source's a<b / a>=b classification, as in its preceding fraction models; applying those inequalities to arbitrary signed denominators would be false. Whole number is explicitly nonnegative. Source math and order remain unchanged. Conversion order uses লবকে হর দিয়ে ভাগ করো, never reverses dividend/divisor. Bengali reference p.51's faulty mixed-number intermediate denominator is excluded.

source_errata.issue: Mixed-number definition calls its fractional part merely a fraction.
source_errata.resolution: Explicitly says proper fraction within the positive mixed-number model, supported by actual TR01 p50 and the source worked examples; preserves source MathML and nonzero denominator conditions.
